poi_note: pois = OSM POIs within 330 m (proxy for Pokestop/gym density)

events.summary: Pokémon GO City Safari Boston, USA: 26-27 Sep 2026, 10:00-18:00 EDT, citywide (ticket only). Explorer-hat Eevee from the City Safari Special Research (evolves into any Eeveelution), an 8-stamp City Safari Stamp Rally at highlighted Pokestops (one Eevee per stamp), event-only wild spawns (Mudbray debut, Unown B/L/M/R, Hawlucha, Oranguru, Komala, Flamigo) plus 7 km eggs (Flabébé Orange Flower, Hawlucha, Mudbray, Komala) and exclusive Field Research. Ticket perks: boosted shiny odds, 4-hour Lures, 5 special trades a day at half Stardust, Tiny Compass buddy souvenir, 8-hour Party Play.
events.summary_ms: Pokémon GO City Safari Boston, USA: 26-27 Sep 2026, 10:00-18:00 EDT, seluruh bandar (kena tiket). Eevee bertopi explorer dari Special Research (boleh evolve jadi mana-mana Eeveelution), Stamp Rally 8 stamp kat Pokestop bertanda (1 Eevee setiap stamp), spawn eksklusif (Mudbray debut, Unown B/L/M/R, Hawlucha, Oranguru, Komala, Flamigo), telur 7 km, dan Field Research khas. Bonus tiket: shiny rate naik, Lure 4 jam, 5 special trade sehari separuh Stardust, souvenir Tiny Compass, Party Play 8 jam.

hotspots.name: Downtown Crossing
hotspots.tip: Washington St shopping core — densest stop cluster in downtown.
hotspots.tip_ms: Terus Washington St shopping — cluster stop paling padat di downtown.

hotspots.name: Boston Common & Public Garden
hotspots.tip: Park loops full of stops, spawns + gyms, spawn-heavy in the morning.
hotspots.tip_ms: Loop taman penuh stop, spawn & gym, paling padat pagi.

hotspots.name: Faneuil Hall / Quincy Market
hotspots.tip: Historic market halls, tourist crowd = heavy lures.
hotspots.tip_ms: Dewan pasar bersejarah, crowd pelancong = lure banyak.

hotspots.name: Copley Square / Back Bay
hotspots.tip: Trinity Church, library, Newbury St — prime downtown grind.
hotspots.tip_ms: Trinity Church, library, Newbury St — grind downtown terbaik.

hotspots.name: Harvard Square (Cambridge)
hotspots.tip: Legendary stop/gym density, most reliable hotspot in Greater Boston.
hotspots.tip_ms: Kepadatan stop/gym legenda, hotspot paling reliable di Greater Boston.

hotspots.name: Kendall Square / MIT (Cambridge)
hotspots.tip: MIT campus edge + Kendall labs, high stop & gym count.
hotspots.tip_ms: Tepi kampus MIT + Kendall lab, stop & gym banyak.

hotspots.tip: Campus-wide gym/stop density — the classic Brisbane grind spot.
hotspots.tip_ms: Seluruh kampus padat gym/stop — spot grind klasik Brisbane.

hotspots.name: Fortitude Valley (Brunswick Street)
hotspots.tip: Chinatown + Brunswick St strip, dense stops and gyms.
hotspots.tip_ms: Chinatown + jalur Brunswick St, stop & gym padat.

hotspots.name: South Bank Parklands (Grey St & Streets Beach)

hotspots.tip_ms: Taman tepi sungai, beach & Cultural Centre — loop senang jalan.

hotspots.tip: Cafes, markets, Boundary St stops — relaxed grind + good coffee.
hotspots.tip_ms: Kafe, market, stop Boundary St — grind santai + kopi sedap.

hotspots.name: Alfama / Castelo de São Jorge
hotspots.tip: Old-town hillside, viewpoints and tram stops — big spawn volume.
hotspots.tip_ms: Bandar lama atas bukit, miradouro & stop tram — spawn banyak.

hotspots.name: Bairro Alto / Príncipe Real

hotspots.name: Praça do Comércio (Terreiro do Paço)
hotspots.tip: Iconic square by the river, easy walking loop to Alfama.
hotspots.tip_ms: Dataran ikonik tepi sungai, senang loop jalan ke Alfama.

hotspots.name: Belém (Mosteiro dos Jerónimos)
hotspots.tip: Monastery + tower + pastéis — tourist cluster, thinner stops but worth a pass.
hotspots.tip_ms: Monasteri + menara + pastel — cluster pelancong, stop kurang tapi berbaloi.

hotspots.tip_ms: Kawasan street-art, kafe & jalan pasar — cluster kedua padat.

hotspots.name: La Canebière / Réformés
hotspots.tip: Main avenue between Vieux-Port and station, non-stop stops.
hotspots.tip_ms: Jalan utama antara Vieux-Port & stesen, stop tak putus.

hotspots.name: Le Panier / Vieux-Port north quay
hotspots.tip: Oldest quarter, narrow lanes full of stops and gyms.
hotspots.tip_ms: Kawasan tertua, lorong sempit penuh stop & gym.

hotspots.name: La Joliette / Les Docks
hotspots.tip: Waterfront redevelopment + MuCEM walk, quieter but steady.
hotspots.tip_ms: Tepi air baru + jalan ke MuCEM, sunyi sikit tapi stabil.

hotspots.name: Castellane / Cours Pierre Puget
hotspots.tip: Roundabout hub linking Prado, beaches and Notre-Dame de la Garde.
hotspots.tip_ms: Hub bulatan sambung Prado, pantai & Notre-Dame de la Garde.

hotspots.tip: Cafe-packed quarter just south of the old town.
hotspots.tip_ms: Kawasan penuh kafe di selatan bandar lama.

hotspots.tip_ms: Pintu masuk Englischer Garten — medan stop luas, senang loop.

hotspots.tip_ms: Stesen + jalur shopping Karlsplatz, player lalu-lalang.

hotspots.tip_ms: Kawasan pelajar + Englischer Garten utara — route grind panjang.

hotspots.name: Theresienwiese (Oktoberfest grounds)

hotspots.tip_ms: Stop sikit je, tapi kalau Oktoberfest 2026 masih jalan (19 Sep–4 Okt) crowd Wiesn buat tempat ni paling meriah.
